limitations: This is a partial estimated approach replay, source frames 5–141. Full camera/geometry alignment and absolute metric accuracy remain unaccepted.
Original fit/reserved roles and screening thresholds are unchanged. Reserved evidence has been inspected during development and is not a blind generalization test.
Native first-frame PSM1 head/shaft alignment improves modestly; visible head and jaw silhouette mismatch remains. Both arms retain Large Needle Driver CAD although the source second tool differs.
The tradeoff worsens reserved PSM1 opposite-cap RMS from 8.884 to 11.411 px and PSM2 incision RMS from 7.272 to 12.642 px (median 10.038 px); both remain within the existing scoped gates.

Needle curvature and grasp are estimates. Native stereo frames 138–140 show a visibly thicker modeled needle and endpoint mismatch; small sharp-vertex surface occlusion remains, so no subpixel or contact-accuracy claim is made.
The optimizer exhausted its 180-evaluation budget. No original camera calibration or exact needle part is available, and the fitted parameters are not a uniquely identified physical calibration.
The fixed pad cannot reproduce later tissue deformation. Full-clip errors remain attached; only the flat backing block is an environmental needle collider.
Original green point-label material bindings and UV texture were carried with the pad without rebinding to source pixels; their current reprojection residuals are retained in point_labels.json.
